name: @nexus/linker
description: A linking job for the Nexus vault: it reads each new transcript note, finds the books, websites, quotes and people it mentions, and joins it to one note for each of them in Mentions/. It runs as a scheduled Cloudflare Worker and as a command in a terminal, and reads and writes the vault through @nexus/agent.
